Say

“One morning the market is crashing. Tech is falling, crypto is collapsing. Should I sell? Hold? Rebalance? Traditional platforms tell you what happened: charts, alerts, endless notifications. But they leave the hardest decision to you. What if your portfolio could actually do something about it?”

Finance Fairies

Your portfolio, guarded by an AI agent.

Say

“Meet Finance Fairies: your personal AI financial guardian. Instead of managing hundreds of assets, you set the rules for the whole portfolio.”

Alex sets two rules. The fairy does the rest.

Acts on its ownExplains every moveText and voice

Say

“Alex tells their fairy: never let my portfolio lose more than 10% from its peak. Never let me lose more than 2% in a single day. If it gets too risky, take action. Always explain why. Alex sets the boundaries; Finance Fairies takes care of the complexity.”

Say

“This is the real engine. Gemini proposes trimming the chip names and adding consumer staples. Before anything trades, the engine checks it: volatility falls from 22.6 to 12.9%, the worst likely day from 3.3 to 1.9%, inside the 2% limit. Small trades go through on their own; this one has a big leg, so the fairy asks first. Autonomous, inside boundaries.”

Demo

What-if → “NVIDIA falls 15% (29 Oct)” → “See what Guardian would do” (instant, recorded Gemini answer). Point at the Gemini card, “Agrees with the engine”, “Gemini proposed, the engine checked it”, “Needs your approval”. AI agent must be on in Settings.

“Why did you do that?”

“Your crypto and tech holdings were driving most of the losses. I chose the plan that cut that exposure while keeping you diversified, to bring you back to the risk you asked for.”

Say

“Autonomy without transparency is dangerous. So every time it acts, it explains why. Let’s ask it. … Alex doesn’t need to analyse 150 assets, just understand their fairy’s decisions. Every action is traceable. Every decision has a reason.”

Say

“Does it work? We replayed Alex’s two rules on real prices in early 2025, through the DeepSeek sell-off. Buy and hold fell 18% and broke the daily limit ten times. The fairy stayed invested, never fell more than 7.2%, and never had a day worse than −2%. Not a guarantee, and on longer runs it gives up some upside. That’s the trade Alex asked for.”
